decision_summary: Approve the QIF v0.3 Discovery Layer design as a planning artifact, not a runtime/schema implementation.
rationale: The design responds to the validated need by separating discovery from QIF representation, defining exploratory Discovery Patterns, preserving candidate status and traceability, and blocking checklist-completion behavior.
recommendation: Use docs/qif-v0.3-discovery-layer-design.md as the scope boundary for the next implementation slice; implement schemas and verifier rules only after this boundary is accepted.
target_audience: QIF maintainers and AI implementation agents
expected_user_reaction: They can plan v0.3 implementation without confusing discovery prompts with QIF quality semantics.
artifact_change_recommendations: Keep Discovery Patterns exploratory, preserve QIF Generation Map traceability, and add schemas only in a later implementation task.
organization_change_recommendations: Treat candidate Quality Intents as requiring governance acceptance before becoming organizational quality knowledge.
